detail.title: Cognitive Foundations of Personal Identity: Autobiographical Memory and Self-Narrative
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes the role of autobiographical memory in the construction and maintenance of personal identity. Research indicates that identity is not a static repository of facts, but a continuously reconstructed narrative dependent on the 'remembering self'.
